name: HC43a: GMH
description:
HC43a. Active ART clients currently in GMH
Number of clients active on ART whose latest documented DSDM model as of the end of the reporting period is Group Models managed by Health Workers.
The client's latest non-null DSDM record on or before :endDate must be GMH: Group models managed by HCW. The client must also be active in care, defined as having an ART encounter during the reporting period or a return_visit_date after :endDate.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h
WHERE h.encounter_datetime <= :endDate
  AND h.dsdm_models = 'GMH: Group models managed by HCW'
  AND h.encounter_datetime = (
      SELECT MAX(h2.encounter_datetime)
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h2
      WHERE h2.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND h2.encounter_datetime <= :endDate
        AND h2.dsdm_models IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = h.patient_id
        AND (
            a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
